qa_pairs.instruction: In the Delimited Text driver, what file extension should be used to have the driver accept input in XML format?
qa_pairs.output: In the Delimited Text driver, to have the driver accept input in XML format, change the input file extension to .xml.

qa_pairs.instruction: How do you configure the Delimited Text driver to process XML-formatted input files?
qa_pairs.output: To configure the Delimited Text driver to process XML-formatted input files, change the input file extension to .xml. The driver will then accept input in XML format.
